items.source: These mocks are useful for developing out-of-container unit tests for code that depends on environment-specific properties.
items.translation: 这些模拟对象可用于开发针对依赖特定环境属性的代码的非容器化单元测试。

items.source: Simple ConfigurableEnvironment implementation exposing MockEnvironment.setProperty(String, Object) and MockEnvironment.withProperty(String, Object) methods for testing purposes.
items.translation: 简单的 `ConfigurableEnvironment` 实现，暴露了用于测试目的的 MockEnvironment.setProperty(String, Object) 和 MockEnvironment.withProperty(String, Object) 方法。

items.source: Simple PropertySource implementation for use in testing.
items.translation: 用于测试的简单 PropertySource 实现。
